answer: The protocol demands 1,000 unit-cycles of deterministic maintenance work to secure each identity, acting as the zenith of operational integrity. An honest agent performs this distinct work, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 units to mimic the labor, creating a ledger that prevents Sybil expansion. A verifier checks the zephyr of outgoing audit logs; any stale proof triggers a penalty on the edge of a ledge, leading to slashing and permanent account termination without refund.
